shortDescription: Manage wireless SSIDs in the Meraki cloud

options.name: ap_availability_tags
options.description: Set whether SSID will be broadcast by APs with tags matching any of the tags in this list. Requires C(available_on_all_aps) to be C(false).

options.name: ap_tags_vlan_ids
options.description: List of VLAN tags. Requires C(ip_assignment_mode) to be C(Bridge mode) or C(Layer 3 roaming). Requires C(use_vlan_tagging) to be C(True).

options.name: auth_key
options.description: Authentication key provided by the dashboard. Required if environmental variable C(MERAKI_KEY) is not set.

options.name: auth_mode
options.description: Set authentication mode of network.

options.name: available_on_all_aps
options.description: Set whether all APs should broadcast the SSID or if it should be restricted to APs matching any availability tags. Requires C(ap_availability_tags) to be defined when set to C(False).

options.name: band_selection
options.description: Set band selection mode.
choices: Dual band operation with Band Steering

options.name: concentrator_network_id
options.description: The concentrator to use for 'Layer 3 roaming with a concentrator' or 'VPN'.

options.name: default_vlan_id
options.description: Default VLAN ID. Requires C(ip_assignment_mode) to be C(Bridge mode) or C(Layer 3 roaming).

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable or disable SSID network.

options.name: encryption_mode
options.description: Set encryption mode of network.

options.name: enterprise_admin_access
options.description: Whether SSID is accessible by enterprise administrators.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname for Meraki dashboard. Can be used to access regional Meraki environments, such as China.

options.name: internal_error_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if server returns an internal server error.

options.name: ip_assignment_mode
options.description: Method of which SSID uses to assign IP addresses.

options.name: lan_isolation_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable Layer 2 Lan isolation. Requires C(ip_assignment_mode) to be C(Bridge mode).

options.name: min_bitrate
options.description: Minimum bitrate (Mbps) allowed on SSID.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of SSID.

options.name: net_id
options.description: ID of network.

options.name: net_name
options.description: Name of network.

options.name: number
options.description: SSID number within network.

options.name: org_id
options.description: ID of organization.

options.name: org_name
options.description: Name of organization.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Instructs module whether response keys should be snake case (ex. C(net_id)) or camel case (ex. C(netId)).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Set amount of debug output during module execution.

options.name: per_client_bandwidth_limit_down
options.description: Maximum bandwidth in Mbps devices on SSID can download.

options.name: per_client_bandwidth_limit_up
options.description: Maximum bandwidth in Mbps devices on SSID can upload.

options.name: psk
options.description: Password for wireless network. Requires auth_mode to be set to psk.

options.name: radius_accounting_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable RADIUS accounting.

options.name: radius_accounting_servers
options.description: List of RADIUS servers for RADIUS accounting.

options.name: radius_coa_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable RADIUS CoA (Change of Authorization) on SSID.

options.name: radius_failover_policy
options.description: Set client access policy in case RADIUS servers aren't available.

options.name: radius_load_balancing_policy
options.description: Set load balancing policy when multiple RADIUS servers are specified.

options.name: radius_proxy_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable RADIUS Proxy on SSID.

options.name: radius_servers
options.description: List of RADIUS servers.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if rate limiter is triggered.

options.name: splash_guest_sponsor_domains
options.description: List of valid sponsor email domains for sponsored guest portal.

options.name: splash_page
options.description: Set to enable splash page and specify type of splash.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies whether SNMP information should be queried or modified.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to timeout for HTTP requests.

options.name: use_https
options.description: If C(no), it will use HTTP. Otherwise it will use HTTPS. Only useful for internal Meraki developers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: use_vlan_tagging
options.description: Set whether to use VLAN tagging. Requires C(default_vlan_id) to be set.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate HTTP certificates.

options.name: visible
options.description: Enable or disable whether APs should broadcast this SSID.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: ID number of VLAN on SSID. Requires C(ip_assignment_mode) to be C(ayer 3 roaming with a concentrator) or C(VPN).

options.name: walled_garden_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable walled garden functionality.

options.name: walled_garden_ranges
options.description: List of walled garden ranges.

options.name: wpa_encryption_mode
options.description: Encryption mode within WPA specification.
